arg.name: map
arg.description: Map name (folder in stack_master/maps/)

arg.name: sim
arg.description: Use simulator (true) or real hardware (false)

arg.name: localization
arg.description: Real-car localization: cartographer | pf | kiss (ignored in sim, which uses gym ground truth)

arg.name: detection_source
arg.description: Obstacle detection front-end: kiss (Livox 3D BevDetector -> kiss_obstacle_bridge) | scan (2D perception/detect on /scan, Hokuyo or pointcloud_to_laserscan)

arg.name: virtual
arg.description: Inject a virtual opponent + static obstacles (on by default in sim, off on the real car; e.g. virtual:=true to overlay a virtual opponent onto the real LiDAR)

arg.name: opp_spawn
arg.description: (virtual) spawn the kinematic opponent at startup on the map centerline; otherwise spawn it with RViz 2D Goal Pose or stack_master/scripts/spawn_opponent.py

arg.name: opp_mode
arg.description: (virtual) opponent driving mode: manual | path (pure-pursuit on the centerline at a constant speed -- deterministic, use for regression runs) | ftg (reactive from its own lidar)

arg.name: ot_planner
arg.description: overtake planner the state machine listens to (ROS1 default = predictive_spliner: listens to BOTH /planner/avoidance/otwpnts (dynamic) AND /planner/avoidance/static_otwpnts (static))

arg.name: control_topic
arg.description: WpntArray the controller follows: /local_waypoints (state-machine output w/ avoidance) or /global_waypoints (robust raceline)

arg.name: use_pp_heading
arg.description: Run pp_heading_controller instead of controller_manager (only one runs)

arg.name: use_hokuyo
arg.description: (real) start the Hokuyo urg_node (/scan). OFF by default: the car runs the Livox MID-360; without /scan the FTG fallback + estop are inert

arg.name: use_livox
arg.description: (real) start the Livox MID-360 driver (/livox/lidar + /livox/imu for kiss 3D localization + detection)

arg.name: rviz
arg.description: (real) also start RViz with the pitwall config (2D Pose Estimate seeds kiss via /initialpose)

arg.name: reopt
arg.description: Obstacle-aware global line (IFAC static re-optimization): static_reopt_node + static_obstacle_layer instead of plain global_trajectory_publisher

arg.name: reopt_safety_width
arg.description: safety_width for the obstacle-aware re-optimizer (tight ifac map solves plain mincurv_iqp only at 0.25 or lower)

arg.name: reopt_obs_change_tol
arg.description: min obstacle move [m] to re-trigger the re-opt QP; larger = detection jitter does not thrash the optimizer. Bounded above by reopt_obs_margin (0.35) minus the SM's static requirement (0.25): a drift this tolerance ignores must not eat that headroom. Was 0.25, which let a box walk the followed line under the SM requirement without re-triggering anything.

arg.name: reopt_clearance_dirty
arg.description: [m] rebuild as soon as the ACTIVE line's clearance to a box it used to clear drops below this, however far the box moved (reopt_obs_change_tol only measures the cause). SM static requirement 0.25 + slack.

arg.name: reopt_compute_sp
arg.description: also re-optimize the shortest_path line (consumed by ot_interpolator); set false only if the OT line is unused

arg.name: reopt_method
arg.description: obstacle-aware line optimizer: local_window (fast ONLINE windowed min-curv QP) | global (legacy whole-track mincurv_iqp, offline-grade)

arg.name: reopt_reach_time
arg.description: [s] DEPRECATED seed for the old speed-scaled reach; the reach is now chosen by a lap-time search over [reach_min, reach_max]. Ignored.

arg.name: reopt_reach_min
arg.description: [m] MIN arc half-width searched. The reach is picked to MINIMISE estimated lap time, not by local speed.

arg.name: reopt_reach_max
arg.description: [m] MAX arc half-width searched. On a short tight track a wide arc is SLOW (ifac: R=10 m costs ~2x the time a reactive line loses); raise only on long open tracks.

arg.name: reopt_qp_veh_width
arg.description: [m] vehicle width for the windowed QP corridor + floor (obstacle clearance is obs_margin, separate)

arg.name: reopt_wall_margin
arg.description: [m] wall reserve of the re-optimized detour. Aligned with the reactive spliner's wall reserve — the recorded apex was DRIVEN at that reserve; a larger value here shrinks the hump below the proven clearance and the all-or-nothing fit rejects it (obstacle stays reactive-only). Was 0.12 here while base_system and the node both default to 0.05: measured on ifac that inflated the worst-case lap loss from +0.49 s to +1.47 s and pushed the laid line past curvlim.

arg.name: reopt_obs_margin
arg.description: [m] clearance of the re-optimized line off each obstacle's edge. MUST be >= the reactive keep-out (width_car/2 + safety_margin in static_avoidance_params.yaml, currently 0.30) or the re-opt line sits inside the reactive planner's own keep-out and gets re-avoided every lap. Run stack_master/scripts/check_avoidance_margins.py after tuning either side.

arg.name: reopt_relax_floor
arg.description: [m] lowest clearance a hump may be ACCEPTED at when reopt_obs_margin is unreachable on either side of the box (coverage ladder). Set at the REACTIVE keep-out (width_car/2 + safety_margin in static_avoidance_params.yaml): below reopt_obs_margin the global line stops relieving the reactive layer of that obstacle, but down to here it still clears it by what the reactive planner would itself have driven. Set equal to reopt_obs_margin to disable the ladder.

arg.name: reopt_apex_merge_gap
arg.description: [m] apex spacing below which two obstacles are treated as ONE cluster by the re-optimizer: same side -> merged into a single hump (weaving back to the raceline between boxes 2 m apart is motion the corridor pays for twice), opposite sides -> dropped as a pair when no reach can swing between them inside the curvature budget. 0 disables the pre-pass.

arg.name: reopt_wall_gate_kernel
arg.description: [cells] erosion kernel of the FINAL wall gate on the re-optimized line: every published point is checked against the map eroded by floor(k/2) cells before the swap is allowed. A published point is a CAR CENTRE, so this must reserve at least half a car -- 7 cells at 0.05 m/px = 0.15 m = width_car/2, matching the reactive planner body_kernel_size. It was 3 (0.05 m), i.e. the line the car follows for every lap after the swap was held to a third of the clearance the reactive planner demands of itself. Never lower it to make a refusal go away: a refusal means a hump the waypoint corridor accepted puts the car body into a wall, and on maps that ship d_left/d_right exchanged this is the only check that can see it. 0 disables the gate.

arg.name: reopt_hold_max_gap
arg.description: [m] widest gap between two SAME-SIDE obstacles the re-optimized line may HOLD its offset across instead of returning to the raceline between them. Returning costs two merge inflections and a speed dip, and buys a stretch of racing line the car leaves again immediately; beyond this gap the stretch is long enough to be worth taking. The held shape is offered to the reach search as an extra CANDIDATE -- the ordinary lap-time ranking still picks the winner. 0 disables it.

arg.name: reopt_hold_kappa_max
arg.description: [1/m] the hold above is only offered where the RACELINE is straight: max |kappa_clean| over the bridged span. In a corner the line between two boxes is the apex, and holding an offset across it gives that away.

arg.name: reopt_fit_tol
arg.description: [m] corridor-fit tolerance of the re-optimizer. The corridor is a smoothed estimate rippling ~2 mm between stations while the amplitude cap parks the hump peak exactly on it, so a zero tolerance rejects every wide reach over a sub-mm violation. Spent out of reopt_wall_margin.
